RULES.DESCRIPTION: Build rules like "when the opportunity enters the Proposal stage, create these tasks". They run as System, are recorded on the opportunity timeline and never send anything to the customer.

TRIGGER_HELP.LOST: Runs right after the built-in lost automations. Here you can filter by lost reason and forward the deal to another unit.

GOALS.TITLE: Sales goals

COMMISSION.TITLE: Seller commission
COMMISSION.DESCRIPTION: Commission = value of the deals won in the month × percent. Start with the general percent; use specific ones only for those paid differently.
COMMISSION.GENERAL_HELP: Applies to every seller and unit without a specific percent.
COMMISSION.NO_SPECIFIC: No specific percent: everybody gets the general one.
COMMISSION.ORDER: When more than one applies, the most specific wins: seller + unit, then seller, then unit, then general.
COMMISSION.MONTHS: Each change applies from the current month on; earlier months keep the percent of their time.
COMMISSION.SAVED: Commission saved. It applies from this month on.

ERRORS.TARGET: Choose a seller, a unit or both.

CHAIN.TITLE: Sequential handoff
CHAIN.DESCRIPTION: When a deal is lost in a unit, it moves on its own to the next unit in the order, and so on until someone wins it or the units run out. The lost deal still counts as lost in its own unit. Nothing is sent to the customer.
CHAIN.ENABLE: Hand the lost deal to the next unit
CHAIN.ENABLE_HELP: Skips units the customer already went through in this journey, units that already have an open deal for them and units without an active pipeline. If an automation rule already forwarded the deal, the handoff does nothing.
CHAIN.ORDER_HELP: Check the units that take part and use the arrows to change the order. Lost in one unit, it goes to the next; after the last one, back to the first.
CHAIN.NEED_UNITS: Choose at least two units to turn the handoff on.
CHAIN.LIMIT: The handoff stops when the customer reaches {max} forwards in the journey (limit in Settings > General).
CHAIN.ASSIGN: Who gets the deal in the next unit
CHAIN.ASSIGN_POOL_HELP: Arrives without owner. Everybody in the unit is notified and sees the deal with the "Take" button.
CHAIN.ASSIGN_ROTATION_HELP: Goes to the next seller of the unit, one at a time, with the "Contact customer" task. Unit without sellers: rotates among managers.
CHAIN.SKIP: Do not hand off when the lost reason is
CHAIN.SKIP_HELP: For example, when the customer gave up buying. Those deals stay lost.
